messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH — inference-gateway (eu-west1) 5xx error-rate spike detected. alert_id=PD12345, threshold=error_rate>3% over 1m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
olivia (oncall): Acked. I'm looking. Any customer-visible reports yet?
matt (eng): seeing a sudden bump in 502 + 504 from proxy tier -> logs show 'upstream reset' in kvcache-proxy. Reproducing in staging? No, only prod eu-west1.
june (support): One customer ticket flagged timeouts ~2:10pm UTC, says ~30% requests returning 502 intermittently. Will surface to CS.
olivia (oncall): Thanks @june. Starting triage: checking recent deploys and autoscale. Can someone paste recent deploy hash?
matt (eng): No deploys in last 30m. Shipping anomaly looks like increase in auth-proxy latency backing up connections. Quick log snippet: ```[2026-03-15T14:09:12Z] proxy: conn error: EOF -> upstream reset (kvcache-192.0.2.14:8080) status=502```
olivia (oncall): Removing a few canaries from eu-west1 routing to test if traffic mix helps. Will reroute 10% off canary pool.
incident-bot: action taken: reroute initiated by olivia to reduce canary weight by 10%. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/inference-5xx.md#step-3
matt (eng): Also bumping kvcache instance count by +2 in eu-west1 to relieve load. Running scale API: `infra scale kvcache eu-west1 +2`
june (support): Noted — informing impacted accounts that we're investigating, ETA 15-30m.
olivia (oncall): After reroute and scale, error rate is dropping from 4.8% -> 1.6% over last 30s. continued monitoring.
sre-next (oncall): If it stabilizes can you schedule a follow-up handoff? I'm ear-marked for next shift at 15:00UTC.
olivia (oncall): Yep. If rate <2% for 5m we'll mark mitigated and handoff. @matt please open a post-incident with logs and root-cause candidates (auth-proxy backlog -> kvcache resets).
matt (eng): Will collect traces, p95 latencies, and kvcache OOM/connection stats, posting to incident doc.
june (support): CS updated customers: initial message sent. Will queue follow-up when we have RCA.
olivia (oncall): Marking mitigated -> error rate under threshold. Leaving note in PD: PD12345 resolved (temporary mitigation: reroute & scale). Handoff to @sre-next for post-mortem and long-term fix.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: RESOLVED PD12345 by olivia. Auto-close window in 1h unless reopened.
sre-next (oncall): Got it, taking post-mortem. I'll pull traces and schedule blameless RCA. Thanks team :thumbsup:
